profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Software engineer with emphasis on algorithms and database design; solid experience building end to end web applications using modern Python and JavaScript frameworks.
I also have a strong background in theoretical computer science and spent years doing research and teaching at Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Continue developing a React app which allows in-flight customers to use Internet Service Provider and Entertainment.
Continue developing a web admin tool used at Panasonic Avionic Inc, a partner of Black Swan Data.

Languages, frameworks, and tools: JavaScript, NodeJS, Swagger, MySQL, Knex and Objection, React, Redux, Angular, RxJS Observable, HTML, CSS, Postman, SequelPro, Gitlab, JIRA, Confluence.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
Designed database, developed a web application for asset management, upgraded app from Python2 to Python3.
On the back-end: PostgreSQL, Django, Django Rest Framework, Python
On the front-end: Node, JavaScript, ES6, React, Redux, Webpack, Highcharts

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a website from the ground up to support products showcase, customer accounts, customized ordering and payment processing system
Designed databases, wrote documentations and guides to help team members work with data and images import 
Languages, frameworks and services used: Python, PostgreSQL, Django, Django REST framework, NodeJS, JavaScript, ES6, React, Redux, Webpack
Measured performance and optimized website loading time by 80% by selectively preloading images and data
Performed DevOps responsibilities, created and maintained weekly build release cycles on Heroku
Supported separate admin pages using Django View Controller

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed web services to handle healthcare data, process customer info and support communication with health service provider
Wrote automated tests for application UI using Python/Selenium
Languages and frameworks: Python/Flask, PostgreSQL, AngularJS, HTML, CSS
